published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Not stated on the cited pages for this line; carbon fiber fill, and Protopasta's CF PLA/PETG rows recommend hard steel nozzle + gears
published_ranges._notes: Product page: nozzle 255+C, 'We print up to 275 C, but 255 C is a good compromise'; processing from 255+C @ 2 mm3/s. Lower CF % than High Strength version (more flex). No density or max flow published.
